content.content: 1. License: no element of the dependent contradicts the prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: The bootstrap is where the invocation's workspace and untracked-state clauses meet; the gate keeps the sequence answerable to both without re-deciding either. Each prerequisite here is a requirement sentence, so the cell is the matrix default — the gate plus a flag to extend the matrix.
